text: [Image #11] this does not remove from the ui. its probably gone in the data. its still in my ui tho
resolution: The NAMES panel ghost-row bug from the user's screenshot (headrest_mount_left lingering after delete): removing/renaming a region drops it from the RESIDENT table immediately, but the name survives in the saved-blob and mount horizons until the next Save, so modelFocusSemantics kept emitting a warning 'saved only' row — an honest drop diagnostic that reads as a failed delete when the drop was deliberate. Fix in ModelView.tsx: editRegion records the old name in a per-model sessionDroppedNamesRef on successful remove/rename; the semantics publisher suppresses non-resident rows carrying a deliberately dropped name; a name returning resident (Ctrl+Z) clears its mark on the next refresh; the set resets on model change. Genuine drops (names lost without a deliberate edit) still surface exactly as before. Cart-side only — hot reload picks it up, no rebuild. Note: the original 'last in the list doesnt remove' message (req_3895) turned out to be aimed at the adjacent terminal pane, but the screenshot bug was real and is fixed here.
